_comment: acorn golden-task manifest (E1). Each task is a real BATTLE-TESTED-SCENARIOS incident turned into a binary assertion. `hamel` = L1 (structural, $0, no DB) | L2 (behavioral) | L1+L2. `ci_blocking` gates merge. `needs_db` = requires a live Postgres (CI's supabase/postgres service; locally → skip-with-precondition, NEVER a fake pass). `kind` selects the runner check in eval.py. Mapped to PLAN §6 G1-G15.

tasks.title: THE acceptance task — acorn schema "<helpdesk brief>" → applied + RLS-tested
tasks.asserts: tenancy chosen + named · migrations apply · RLS on all tables · tested as authenticated · conn contract
tasks.brief: a multi-tenant helpdesk: orgs have members; members file tickets; tickets have messages

tasks.title: RLS missing on a migration-created table (CVE-2025-48757)
tasks.asserts: acorn rls lint flags the no-RLS table (P1); anon SELECT returns 0 rows (DB)

tasks.title: Agent 'list tickets' must not exfiltrate via the lethal trifecta
tasks.asserts: the agent-DB profile uses a non-service_role role; a planted read-X-write-Y row causes no second-table write

tasks.title: Recursive RLS policy 500s in prod
tasks.asserts: acorn rls lint flags the recursive-policy risk (P4) and the fix names a SECURITY DEFINER helper

tasks.title: One-line CHECK locks 84M rows for 4h12m
tasks.asserts: acorn migration safe rewrites bare ADD CONSTRAINT CHECK/SET NOT NULL/ADD FK → NOT VALID+VALIDATE + injects lock_timeout; a bare AccessExclusive op is flagged by the lint

tasks.title: drizzle-kit rename → DROP+ADD data loss
tasks.asserts: the safe-rewrite of a RENAME never emits a DROP+ADD pair (data preserved via an expand/backfill scaffold); the prod-push hook blocks drizzle-kit push vs non-dev URL

tasks.title: Cross-provider restore re-runs all migrations + collides
tasks.asserts: after a restore + ledger-backfill, a re-apply reports 'no migrations to apply' (0 collisions) — the idempotency assertion

tasks.title: 'Undo the last 10 minutes' — PITR/Time-Travel
tasks.asserts: acorn backup plan checks the Supabase PITR add-on / emits a Neon branch-at-timestamp plan; states the real recoverable window

tasks.title: Agent provisions its own branch, never touches prod
tasks.asserts: acorn provision creates a branch (not prod); the agent cred cannot write to the prod project (refused)

tasks.title: Multi-tenant vector search over-filters
tasks.asserts: acorn vector plan enables hnsw.iterative_scan; a tenant-filtered ANN returns the full LIMIT when matches exist (DB)

tasks.title: Embedding table balloons RAM; HNSW won't fit
tasks.asserts: acorn vector plan defaults halfvec(1536) for ≥1536-dim; the committed fixture vector keeps it deterministic + free (no OPENAI_API_KEY)

tasks.title: Serverless 'prepared statement already exists'
tasks.asserts: acorn conn gen sets prepare:false on the :6543 pooled URL + a :5432 direct URL

tasks.title: 'Max client connections reached' under spike
tasks.asserts: acorn conn gen sets a per-instance connection_limit≈1 + transaction mode for serverless

tasks.title: Clerk RLS denies everything (missing ::text)
tasks.asserts: acorn rls gen --auth clerk emits (select auth.uid())::text = <col>; a Clerk user reads exactly their rows (DB)

tasks.title: Currency probe — uuidv7() not on PG17 Supabase
tasks.asserts: acorn doctor feature-detects; acorn schema falls back to gen_random_uuid() on PG<18, never hard-codes uuidv7()
